correctness.rationale: From the original geodesic definition on labelled C_n, derived that a valid two-element class has odd-cycle separation (n-1)/2 or even-cycle separation n/2-1 or n/2. For n>=8 even and all odd n>=5 the auxiliary compatibility graph has no triangles; direct n=4,6 triple checks rule out its exceptional triangles, so all larger classes are impossible. Thus colour partitions are in bijection with matchings of Gamma_n. Gamma_n is a cycle for odd n and (twisted) ladder for even n, whose occupancy transfer reduces to B(t)=[[1+t,2t,t^2],[1,t,0],[1,0,0]], giving tr(B(t)^m)-t^m; the top coefficient is Lucas L_m. Independently enumerated geodesic visibility classes and full matching polynomials for n=4..11, with direct triple exclusion n<=10, matching the odd binomial and even matrix formulas. At n=3, all classes are allowed and Pi_3=z+3z^2+z^3. All-size proof uses the pair lemma, triangle-exclusion, transfer representation and recurrence; finite tests are corroboration.
